audit_items.title: Supporting Check: Does the validation correctly handle the case when shuffling is NOT yet available for the sidecar's slot?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Abstract interpretation analysis reveals a critical state-space anomaly where the implementation conflates 'shuffling unavailable' with 'proposer mismatch', violating spec requirement to IGNORE (not REJECT) when shuffling data cannot be computed.

state_anomalies_found.description: Four different error paths all return errSidecarUnexpectedProposer: (1) TargetRootForEpoch fails, (2) parentState replay fails, (3) ComputeProposer fails, (4) proposer index mismatch. Paths 1-3 indicate shuffling unavailable (should IGNORE per spec), path 4 is actual invalidity (should REJECT). Caller cannot distinguish these cases.
state_anomalies_found.spec_violation: Spec states: 'If the proposer_index cannot immediately be verified against the expected shuffling, the sidecar MAY be queued for later processing... do not REJECT, instead IGNORE this message.' Implementation REJECTs all cases.

error_return_domain.impact: During reorgs or initial sync, honest peers are penalized for valid sidecars when parent block not yet in forkchoice

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Symbolic execution confirms reachable path where shuffling unavailable leads to peer penalty.

attack_paths.description: Honest peer sends valid blob sidecar before parent block arrives in forkchoice
preconditions: fc.TargetRootForEpoch(blob.ParentRoot(), epoch) returns error (parent not in forkchoice)
Blob is valid with correct signature and proposer_index
attack_paths.impact: Unbounded peer penalty accumulation during network latency
attack_paths.reachability: HIGH - occurs during normal reorg or initial sync

phase3_invariant_analysis.summary: Property violated: honest peers should not be penalized for valid sidecars when shuffling temporarily unavailable.

invariant_violations.property: ∀ honest_peer p, ∀ valid_sidecar s, shuffling_unavailable(s) → IGNORE(s) ∧ ¬REJECT(s)

bug_bounty_classification.impact: Can cause mass peer disconnections during reorgs

audit_items.recommendation: Introduce errSidecarShufflingUnavailable error type. Update callers to map this to pubsub.ValidationIgnore instead of ValidationReject.
